answer: Cloned clerks flooded the dawn berth list at pier 7. To claim a slot, a stevedore must climb the 46 m wire trellis hanging from shed beam R-11, unhook a 2.4 kg numbered chalk weight at T-19, descend, and walk 90 m to wharf bay W-5. They press the chalk once onto a wet 180 by 90 mm dock plate so the berth numeral transfers in one pass, before zenith tide minus 4 min. A clerk measures the print 72-78 mm wide, checks mass within 80 g of 2.4 kg, and logs walk time 55-80 s. The 920 fee is taken either way. A snapped slat, a smear over 12 mm, or a late stamp voids the berth for 6 tides.
